text:
jordan: Heads-up — onboarding a new checkpoint (gs://redwood-models/llama-variant/v2/weights.tar.gz). Seeing difference in how the tokenizer preserves chat delimiters vs our reference. Not blocking but affects prompt formatting.

sam: can you paste the minimal repro prompt + observed token ids?

jordan: yep. repro prompt: "<SYS>Assistant:</SYS> Hello
User: What is 2+2?"
token ids (from model tokenizer): [2, 345, 789, 4] — note no dedicated token for <SYS> wrapper, it gets split.

akiko: is this the variant that strips the leading start-of-sequence token on encode? iirc some forks set add_bos=false.

jordan: looks like add_bos=false in the tokenizer config: 
```
{"add_bos": false, "eos_token": "</s>", "special_tokens": {"user":"<usr>", "assistant":"<ast>"}}
```

mike: that explains it. Our chat template generator assumes a preserved start token so we rely on prefix caching. If add_bos is false, cached prefix isn't matching runtime tokens — fallback to full recalc -> latency spike.

sam: short-term options: 1) map their special tokens into our chat template (postprocess raw ids back to wrappers), 2) set add_bos on encode in the serving adapter, 3) recommend tokenizer rework in model repo. Which do you prefer?

jordan: leaning to (2) in serving adapter to keep model as-is. implemented as a thin wrapper that prepends a synthetic bos id before sending to runtime. perf-wise it's cheap.

akiko: beware: if they have different eos handling we must trim trailing eos on decode or we double-terminate. Add a unit test: encode(decode(x)) symmetric for few sample prompts.

model-bot: deployed tokenization test runners for job #4122 — results pending (will post once jobs finish). :robot_face: 

mike: also check kv-cache alignment when prefix is synthetic. Some of our attention kernel paths expect the cache start offset matching original token stream. Might need a cache-offset fix in runtime router.

jordan: noted. I'll open a tiny PR to serving-adapter with a flag preserve_chat_prefix=true that will prepend BOS id for this model id. ping @sam for review.

sam: Ping received — will review today. Also please add a short note in the model onboarding checklist: "verify tokenizer.add_bos and special_token mapping vs platform chat template".

akiko: +1. add a unit that runs prompt set vs token ids and fails on mismatch >2 tokens.

jordan: done — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/128 (WIP). includes tests, adapter flag, and a short note in onboarding docs.

mike: can you drop the exact GCS path into the PR description and add the failing sample so QA can reproduce locally?

jordan: done. QA repro included. model-bot: any status on the tokenization test job?

model-bot: job #4122 finished: 8/10 prompts symmetric, 2/10 require synthetic BOS to match. Attached small log: 
```
prompt 7 mismatch: encoded ids (no bos) [12,45,67] expected [1,12,45,67]
```

sam: OK that's actionable. Thanks Jordan — if adapter flag works we can onboard without changing upstream weights. After we merge i'll schedule a short run on dedicated to validate latencies.

jordan: awesome. will follow up after review/merge. :thumbsup: 

mike: one last note — add a line in the rollout policy to fallback to a compatible model variant if tokenizer mismatch persists. small config: 
```
"fallback_policy": {"on_tokenizer_mismatch": "use-compatible-variant"}
```

akiko: logging: include a tokenizer-compatibility metric so we can alert when >5% of requests require synthetic-prefixing.

jordan: added metric ticket #789 to product.

sam: great thread. closing once PR merged and dedicated run passes.
